description.name: Holy Radiant Shield: 75%
description.text: Returns 75% of the damage taken to the attacker as Holy damage capped at 9999

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken 2P
description.text: White Magic abilities don't consume uses, White Magic abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Banishra after using 2 White Magic abilities
